summary: Azul S.A. filed Form 6-K with MD&A disclosing completion of its emergence from Chapter 11 reorganization on February 20, 2026. Key terms: conversion of first-lien and second-lien debt into equity; equity rights offering raised ~R$5.0 billion; issuance of $1.375B 9.875% senior secured notes due 2031; repayment of DIP financing. Debt decreased from R$23.1B to R$9.7B. The plan was court-confirmed. A non-cash deferred tax asset of R$7.5B was recognized. Watch for post-emergence equity trading and ability to service new notes.
